description: Render the business's QR codes as a printable file and return a download URL. Every code is a short link (lknd.to/<code>) the owner can re-point without reprinting. purpose: menu (one code to the menu site, repeated `copies` times), table_ordering (ONE CODE PER TABLE, each with its table name printed under it — needs tables, see create_tables) or link (its short links). format: home_pdf (sheets with cut guides on any paper: a4, a3, a5, letter, or custom with paper_width_mm and paper_height_mm; layout large=1, medium=4, small=12 per page, or size_mm for an exact code width with as many per page as fit), press_pdf (print shop: one code per page at size_mm wide, 3 mm bleed, trim box and crop marks, all vector) or svg_zip (one vector SVG per code, for a designer). Uses the saved design (get_qr_design) unless `design` overrides it for this file only.

copies.description: menu/link: copies of each code; default fills one sheet

cut_lines.description: home_pdf: dashed cut guides around each code; default true

accent.description: Frame color: caption text, card fill

cta.description: Optional text above the code, e.g. "Scan to order". null = none (only the name is printed)

eye_style.description: Corner markers: square, rounded or circle

frame.description: none (code + label only), caption (call-to-action text above the code) or card (filled color card around the code)

logo.description: Put the business logo in the middle

show_label.description: Print the table's name under each per-table code (default true). Only turn off for stickers fixed to their table: on a stand that can move, an unnamed code sends orders to the wrong table

layout.description: home_pdf: default medium; ignored when size_mm is set

print_link.description: Also return print_link: a short link to forward to a print shop, opening a download page with the press PDF + SVGs and their specs (expires in 60 days). Default true for press_pdf and svg_zip

shortlink_ids.description: link: which short links (default all); menu: the short link to encode

size_mm.description: Printed code width in mm. press_pdf/svg_zip: default 90. home_pdf: exact width instead of a layout

table_ids.description: table_ordering: which tables; default all active ones

name: export_qr_codes
title: Export qr codes
